details:
I took this image from @evalka on Discord and their own redesign post, and I want to say that while it is unlikely that their entire design will be take into consideration, I want to point out something that should be manageable for developers to implement.

In their redesign, they’ve moved the user details (ID verification, avatar performance, and trust rank) to a separate bubble at the bottom of nameplate. I think this change is great, and if developers take nothing else from their idea, it should be this one.

Why? Because it’s easy to read at a glance and in a familiar place for players. Currently in beta, these icons have been shoved away and made somewhat hard to see. In live, you can glance up at someone’s head, and attain all of this information easily.

I also want to add that, if developers do implement this change, it will make room for moderation actions (earmuff mode, muted, etc.) to the left of it, and platform indicators somewhere because in my opinion, those are things that need to be seen and are essential to the everyday player experience. Other feedback posts have already pointed this out, so I won’t go on.

Please see @evalka’s image below, and consider the idea. (Also, they fixed the group banners, developers!!!)
title: [1878] Move user detail icons to be more visible
